original_excerpts.name: lfs-spec-v3.6.1.md
original_excerpts.locator: The Pointer / required keys; Intercepting Git
original_excerpts.excerpt: The core Git LFS idea is that instead of writing large blobs to a Git repository, only a pointer file is written. / Currently, only `sha256` is supported. / `size` is in bytes. / Note that the `clean` filter does not push the file to the server. Use the `git push` command to do that (lfs files are pushed before commits in a pre-push hook).

original_excerpts.excerpt: If you make a 1 byte change and push the file again, you'll use another 500 MB of storage / If you download a 500 MB file that's tracked with Git LFS, you'll use 500 MB of the repository owner's bandwidth. / Bandwidth and storage usage always count against the repository owner's account.
